name: wolftac-factory
description: Spec, build, independently review, and integrate one issue at a time through the Wolftac software factory.

interface.longDescription: Creates build-ready Linear specifications, implements one queued issue in an isolated worktree, independently reviews the published commit, and merges it only after the verified human approval.
defaultPrompt: Use $wolftac-build to build one queued issue.
Use $wolftac-review to review one built issue.
Use $wolftac-integrate to land one Approved issue.
